summary: Completed frontend-only UI/integration testing of Council Wealth terminal. Tested all 6 screens (Dashboard, New Session, Live Session x2 states, Audit & Replay, Integrations, Tenant Admin), left-nav routing, state badges, live streaming simulation, and right rail. Found 1 functional bug (Audit search input is not wired), 1 React hydration warning (nested button), and otherwise everything renders and integrates correctly.

ui_bugs.issue: The search input has no value/onChange binding. Typing 'Carter', '2040', or 'zzzzz' all return the same 7 rows — search is purely cosmetic. There is also no `query` state variable in the component.

Nested <button> inside <button>: the provider-card is a <button> and contains a 'Sync now' inner <button> at line 113. Causes React hydration warning: 'In HTML, <button> cannot be a descendant of <button>.' Change outer card to a div with role=button or convert inner 'Sync now' to a styled span / onClick-stop.

action_items: Wire the Audit search input: add a `query` state, bind value/onChange, and filter the session list client-side by id/client name (use existing useMemo over AUDIT_SESSIONS).

Fix nested <button> in Integrations provider cards: either make the outer card a div with onClick+role=button (preserve keyboard accessibility) or replace the inner 'Sync now' <button> with a span + stopPropagation handler.
critical_code_review_comments: AuditViewer: search input is declared but has no state/handler (line 94-98). Dead UI.
Integrations: Nested <button> elements break HTML validity and generate React hydration warnings on every page load.
NewSession handleRun() always navigates to '/council/live/CW-2041' regardless of form inputs — acceptable for frontend-only mock, but document this.
AuditViewer filter dropdowns (Client/Advisor/Date/Jurisdiction) are static labels with no functional bindings — noted as mock.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL: https://component-hub-64.preview.emergentagent.com. Viewport 1920x900. All 6 screens work end-to-end. Verified: KPI strip (5 tiles), 8 recent session rows, 6 integration tiles, live stream simulation (11 lines after 5s), 14 agent cards grouped by 4 layers, recommendation tabs (summary/actions/risks/audit), CW-2040 VETOED banner + blocked panel, 6 providers (Wealthbox, Salesforce FSC, Orion Advisor, Black Diamond, Plaid, Morningstar Direct), 6 sync history rows, 6 admin tabs switch content, 8 feature-flag toggles update state, right rail on all pages. Pending fixes: (1) Audit search wiring, (2) nested-button hydration warning in Integrations provider cards.
